en.headline: Senior police superintendent jailed nearly six months for indecent assault
en.dek: Ian Chow Ngai-kong was sentenced at West Kowloon Court after being convicted of assaulting a Civil Service Bureau clerk on three occasions at police headquarters in 2024.
body: A senior Hong Kong police superintendent was sentenced on Friday to five months and three weeks in prison for indecently assaulting a clerical officer at police headquarters.

Senior Superintendent Ian Chow Ngai-kong, 51, had earlier been found guilty by West Kowloon Magistrate Vivian Ho Wai-han of three counts of indecent assault. The offences occurred on 19 June and 1 November 2024 at the force’s Wan Chai headquarters and involved a senior clerical officer from the Civil Service Bureau.

The magistrate described the acts as brazen and unacceptable in the workplace. Chow was released on HK$100,000 bail pending an appeal to the High Court and is not required to begin the sentence immediately.
Defence submissions included 22 character references. Chow had denied making any obscene remarks, though he admitted touching the woman’s waist on one occasion.

zh.headline: 高級警司非禮文員判囚近六個月
zh.dek: 周艾剛於西九龍法院被判刑，早前裁定他在2024年於警察總部三次非禮一名公務員事務局文員罪名成立。
body: 一名香港高級警司星期五因非禮一名文員，被判監禁五個月零三星期。
51歲高級警司周艾剛早前被西九龍裁判法院裁判官何蕙嫻裁定三項非禮罪成立。案中受害人是一名公務員事務局高級文員，事件發生於2024年6月19日及11月1日警察總部。
裁判官形容被告行為公然及在工作場所不可接受。周艾剛獲准以10萬元保釋，等候高等法院上訴，暫無需即時服刑。
辯方提交了22封求情信。周艾剛否認說過任何淫褻說話，但承認曾一次觸摸女事主腰部。
